phases.name: Foundations & Movement Prep
phases.focus: Restore balanced strength, mobility, and low-impact movement patterns while protecting the repaired right medial meniscus.

phases.name: Strength Build (Low-Impact)
phases.focus: Progress overall and unilateral strength with controlled ranges, increased load, and emphasis on joint control without deep knee flexion or impact.

phases.name: Ski-Specific Strength & Transfer
phases.focus: Develop sport-specific strength, endurance and stability for skiing with low-impact, loaded positional work and neural preparation for return to ski tasks.

non_negotiables: No deep knee flexion under load
Low-impact only as cleared by surgeon
Progress only within pain-free ranges and patient-reported tolerance
Use full gym equipment but choose variations that avoid deep knee bend (e.g., box/quarter/partial range, belt squats, split squats limited ROM)
Monitor swelling or increased knee effusion; back off if symptoms increase

PLAN "12-week Low-Impact Strength for Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS

PHASES

      DAY Lower training 60m "Lower - bilateral control":

          cycling 8m
          hip_circles 2m
          ankle_circles 1m
          band_walks 4m

          belt_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          quad_stretch 5m
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Upper training 55m "Upper - push/pull strength":

          rowing 6m
          arm_circles 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m

          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds

          chest_stretch 4m
          shoulder_stretch 4m
